hero.title: Museum-grade custody for trading cards
hero.lede: Store graded cards with Crown Fine Art, track ownership online, and connect each vaulted asset to a verifiable digital record.
hero.note: Available to invited partners & collectors during launch.

protection.title: Five Layers of Certainty
protection.lede: A simple custody model: secure storage, verified assets, digital ownership, clear access, and traceable status.

security.title: Museum-Grade Security
security.text: Stored with Crown Fine Art in a museum-grade vault - 24/7 surveillance, multi-layered security systems, and climate control.

authenticated.title: Authenticated & Secure
authenticated.text: Each card is authenticated by the Grade10 team alongside professional graders, and protected throughout storage and ownership.

tokenized.title: Tokenized Ownership
tokenized.text: Each card is minted as a digital twin on the Solana blockchain, ensuring immutable, verifiable ownership.

complimentary.title: Complimentary Storage
complimentary.text: All PSA, CGC, SGC and BGS graded cards are vaulted free during launch - exclusively for invited partners and collectors.

traceable.title: Real-Time Traceability
traceable.text: Track your card at every step, from intake to secure storage, with clear status updates throughout.

digital.title: What Happens After a Card Is Vaulted
digital.lede: Physical custody, ownership records, and market value are connected into one traceable asset view.

custody.title: The Card Stays Protected
custody.text: The graded card remains in secure storage with Crown Fine Art.

twin.title: Ownership Is Recorded
twin.text: A matching on-chain record links the owner to the vaulted asset.

value.title: Pricing Stays Visible
value.text: Market data and Grade10 AI help keep valuation context current.

solana.title: What’s Solana?
solana.body: The public blockchain used for fast, transparent ownership records linked to the vaulted physical card.
solana.why: Ownership can be verified without moving the physical card out of secure custody.

request.title: Submit Your Vault Request
request.text: Use the Vault form to reserve a drop-off appointment or register a mail-in shipment.

handOff.title: Hand Off Your Cards
handOff.text: Drop off in person, or ship with your Shipment ID via SF Express, FedEx, DHL, or another major courier.

track.title: Track Secure Custody
track.text: After intake, your cards move into secure storage and appear online with traceable status and ownership records.

custody.title: Secure Custody
custody.text: Stored with Crown Fine Art in a climate-controlled facility with 24/7 surveillance and controlled access.

access.title: Clear Access
access.text: View ownership records and vault status online after intake.

records.title: Auditable Records
records.text: Traceable status, independent reports, and a clean custody history.

viewing.text: Vault visits available by request for vaulted cards.

secure.a: Yes. All cards are stored with Crown Fine Art in a museum-grade vault with 24/7 surveillance, multi-layered security, and climate control - under institutional governance and independent audits.

send.q: How do I send my items to the Vault?
send.a: Start with the on-page Vault request form. Choose drop-off or mail-in, then our team confirms the appointment or shipment details before intake.

view.q: Can I view my items once they’re in the Vault?
view.a: Anytime. Track digital ownership records online on the Grade10 website, and request private on-site vault visits to view your cards in person.

fees.a: During the launch period, storage is complimentary for invited partners and collectors - all PSA, CGC, SGC and BGS graded cards are vaulted free.

tokenization.q: How does tokenization work for vaulted cards?
tokenization.a: Each card is minted as a digital twin on the Solana blockchain, creating an immutable ownership record linked to its secure physical custody.

cta.title: Questions About Vaulting?
cta.body: Our team responds promptly. Ask about eligibility, intake, custody, or viewing access during launch.
